# Template: ring_molecule
A skeletal chemistry ring (benzene-style hexagon or 5-ring): optional heteroatoms at vertices, alternating aromatic double bonds, and substituents pointing outward. Choose this scene for requests about aromatic rings, benzene/pyridine/furan-style molecules, functional groups on a ring, or simple 'draw molecule X' requests where X is a substituted ring. Skeletal convention: unlabeled vertices are carbons; bonds trim at labeled atoms. Vertex positions are indexed 0 at the top going counter-clockwise.
Parameter schema:
{
 "type": "object",
 "properties": {
  "ring_size": {
   "type": "number",
   "enum": [
    5,
    6
   ],
   "description": "Default 6."
  },
  "atoms": {
   "type": "array",
   "items": {
    "type": [
     "string",
     "null"
    ]
   },
   "description": "Per-vertex atom symbol (index 0 = top). \"C\" or null = skeletal carbon (no label). E.g. pyridine: [null, null, \"N\", null, null, null]."
  },
  "aromatic": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Alternating inner double bonds."
  },
  "substituents": {
   "type": "array",
   "items": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
     "position": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Vertex index 0..ring_size-1."
     },
     "text": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "e.g. \"OH\", \"CH₃\", \"COOH\" (unicode subscripts welcome)."
     }
    },
    "required": [
     "position",
     "text"
    ]
   }
  },
  "name": {
   "type": "string",
   "description": "Caption under the molecule."
  }
 }
}
Element ids your commands can reference:
- ring: the ring bonds (one group); its centre is the ring centre, so a gesture at the middle is {"point": {"at": {"ref": "ring"}, "gesture": "circle"}}
- double_bonds: inner aromatic double-bond strokes (when aromatic)
- atom_<i>: heteroatom symbol at vertex i
- sub_<i>: substituent at vertex i (spur + text)
- molecule_name: the caption
Examples:
Request: "Draw benzene." → params: {"ring_size":6,"aromatic":true,"name":"Benzene C₆H₆"}
Request: "Draw phenol with the OH group." → params: {"ring_size":6,"aromatic":true,"substituents":[{"position":0,"text":"OH"}],"name":"Phenol"}

In YAML: `template: ring_molecule` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
